properties.region_designation: Cairngorms National Park, Badenoch and Strathspey, Scotland

properties.bedrock_formation: Grampian Group Neoproterozoic metasedimentary psammite and semipelite, intruded by Caledonian granite plutons
properties.superficial_deposits: Quaternary glaciolacustrine sands, hummocky glacial moraine till, and Strathspey outwash gravels
properties.topsoil: Podzolic, humic-rich peaty sandy loam, highly permeable with localized subsoil compaction along agricultural lanes
properties.hydrology: Gentle westward drainage feeding unchannelled agricultural swales toward the River Spey floodplain

properties.typology: Highland agricultural steadings, outbuildings, and farm dwelling

materials.facade: Whitewashed roughcast harling over local fieldstone granite rubble
materials.roof: Gable-ended Scottish Ballachulish slate with dual chimney stacks and zinc ridge cappings
materials.fenestration: Painted white timber-framed sash and case windows, recessed deep in masonry reveals

materials.facade: Profiled goosewing-grey plastisol corrugated metal cladding over concrete base walls
materials.roof: Low-pitch fiber-cement sheeting with translucent corrugated skylight panels
materials.openings: Wide sliding galvanized metal equipment doors

materials.facade: Weathered corrugated steel and rustic vertical timber boarding
materials.roof: Corrugated iron roofing sheet with aged rust oxidation patina

properties.infrastructural_surfaces: Compacted pale granite-grit farm tracks, weathered crushed stone yards, and perimeter sheep fencing

properties.vegetation_cover: Improved upland pasture, coarse bentgrass (Agrostis), sheep's fescue, patchworks of heather (Calluna vulgaris) along field fringes
properties.tree_canopy: Native Scots Pine (Pinus sylvestris), downy birch (Betula pubescens), and dense riparian scrub bordering field boundaries

properties.lighting_condition: Crisp sub-Arctic northern light, filtered by high cirrostratus clouds, casting soft-edged directional shadows northeastward across the pastoral slopes
properties.atmospheric_haze: Clear, crisp mountain air with mild atmospheric blue scattering softening the distant Monadhliath foothills
